thread:
keisha: Skyline Health just pinged billing ops  their marketplace invoice shows a vendor pass-through fee of $7,250 for a partner integration they never enabled. Can we audit and adjust?

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice MKP-7009 attached (2027-07-14). Line items include: Partner integration pass-through $7,250 (status: paid).
omar: I see the partner meter id in the bill: mkp-int-92. Partner records show an activation event on 2027-07-01 triggered by partner webhook wp-attach-11. Customer claims they never clicked enable.
talia: Quick check: Skyline's account shows a deferred activation flag set by migration script MIG-2027-06-30. Looks like the migration toggled the partner flag for a subset of accounts. Ticket #72190 has the customer's report.
keisha: So this is an internal migration causing an unintended enable. For customer outcome, propose full reversal of the $7,250 pass-through and a $250 goodwill credit for their ops time.
yvonne: Accounting constraints: partner pass-through reversals should be split between Partner-Recoverable (we attempt to bill partner) and Promo credit for the goodwill. Proposed GL entries: AR-Adj (6165) -$7,250, Partner-Recoverable (8209) +$7,250; Goodwill Promo (7740) -$250.
acct-bot: [automated] Policy check: refunds >$5,000 require VP Finance sign-off. Routing approval request PRQ-9987.
omar: I'll draft the external note to Skyline and loop in partner-ops for recovery. Also flag the migration script for rollback.
keisha: Finance: if VP approves, please create adjustment and publish updated invoice MKP-7009-v2. Omar please include partner id and migration evidence in the note.
yvonne: VP Finance approved PRQ-9987 for $7,500 total (includes goodwill). :white_check_mark: Proceed with adjustment.
billing-bot: [automated] Adjustment created ADJ-10011. Credits applied: $7,500 (includes $250 goodwill). Updated invoice MKP-7009-v2.pdf. Accounting refs: ADJ-10011 / AR-6165 / PART-8209 / PROMO-7740.
keisha: Draft external message: "Hi Skyline team  thanks for flagging. During a recent account migration a partner integration flag was incorrectly toggled for some customers which resulted in a partner pass-through charge on your invoice. We've reversed the $7,250 charge and added a $250 goodwill credit; your updated invoice MKP-7009-v2 is published and the credit will reflect on your next statement. We're reverting the migration change and will follow up with an RCA. Apologies for the disruption. - Keisha, Billing Ops"
omar: Sent. Skyline replied: "Thanks for resolving this so quickly. Please keep us posted on partner recovery." Closing ticket #72190.
talia: Internal action: rollback MIG-2027-06-30 for the affected cohort and add a migration-check to prevent auto-enable of partner integrations. Tagging eng-migrations and partner-ops.
keisha: Closing thread.
